title: 第25章 少女心思第26章 附属传送阵
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
紧随其后的是，混乱的格挡和呼声。
“小心！”
“杨伟兄！”
“少爷！
！”
惊呼声、马匹的嘶鸣声乱成一团。
杨伟带来的护卫们这才反应过来，惊慌失措地冲向摔得七荤八素的主子。
“呸！
真他娘的晦气！”
沈算看都懒得再看一眼，毫不犹豫地一夹马腹，“驾！”
纵马绝尘而去！
不跑，留下来等着对方叫家长来群殴吗？他又不傻！
钟源见状，立刻策马紧随其后护卫。
他刚才那一掌留了分寸，只用了柔劲震飞对方，并未造成实质重伤，纯粹是小惩大诫。
身后，尘土弥漫中传来杨伟破了音的、歇斯底里的怒吼：“小杂种！
有种别跑！
看我爹杨刚不打断你的狗腿！
扒了你的皮……！”
“唉，看来麻烦是免不了了。”
纵马疾驰的沈算忍不住暗叹一声。

两世为人的他，始终无法理解，这些有权有势的人家，为何总能把后代养成这般无法无天、视他人如草芥的纨绔？
这简直就是不给底层百姓活路啊！
两人一路沉默，气氛有些压抑。
直至在城外驿站还了马匹，步行朝内城走去时，钟源才忍不住开口，眼中带着煞气：“少爷，属下回去就让人查，掘地三尺也要把那杨伟和他爹杨刚的底细查个底朝天！”
“嗯，”
沈算摸着下巴，眼神冷静，“他应该不是南内城的人。”
“很大可能是南外城某个势力，比如帮派、商行或狩猎团的少爷。”
“你可以先找陈大壮旁敲侧击地打听打听。”
“正好，也借此试探一下烈焰狩猎团对咱们的真实态度。”
钟源眼睛一亮，佩服道：“少爷高见，一举两得。
确实需要看看这‘打八折’的香火情，值不值得咱们继续投入！”
他心中感叹：少爷行事，总是思虑周全，走一步看三步，自己真是拍马难及。
content_en:
What followed was chaotic blocking and shouting.
"Be careful!"
"Brother Yang Wei!"
"Master!
! "
There were exclamations and the neighing of horses.
Only then did the guards brought by Yang Wei react and rush towards their master who was badly beaten in a panic.
“Bah!
What a damn bad luck! "
Shen Suan didn't even bother to look at it again, and without hesitation he pinched the horse's belly and said, "Drive!"
Riding away like a horse!
Don't run away, but stay and wait for the other party to call the parents for a group fight? He's not stupid!
When Zhong Yuan saw this, he immediately rode his horse to protect him.
The palm he just struck was measured and he only used gentle force to knock the opponent away. It did not cause any serious injury. It was purely a small punishment but a big warning.
Behind him, Yang Wei's hysterical roar could be heard in the dust: "You little bastard!
Don’t run if you have the guts!
See if my father, Yang Gang, doesn't break your legs!
I'll peel off your skin...! "
"Alas, it seems trouble is inevitable."
Shen Suan, who was galloping on his horse, couldn't help but sigh inwardly.
Having lived in two lifetimes, he still couldn't understand why these powerful families could always raise their offspring to be such lawless dandies who treat others as nothing more than trivial matters.
This is simply not giving the people at the bottom a way to survive!
The two of them were silent all the way, and the atmosphere was a bit depressing.
It wasn't until he returned the horses at the post station outside the city and walked towards the inner city that Zhong Yuan couldn't help but speak, with an evil look in his eyes: "Master, when I get back, I'll have people investigate. I'll dig down three feet to get to the bottom of Yang Wei and his father Yang Gang!"
"Well,"
Shen Suan touched his chin, his eyes calm, "He shouldn't be from South Inner City."
"It is very likely that he is a young master from a certain force in the Southern Outer City, such as a gang, a trading company or a hunting group."
"You can first ask Chen Dazhuang to make some insinuations."
"Just in time, we can also take this opportunity to test the true attitude of the Flame Hunting Group towards us."
Zhong Yuan's eyes lit up and he said with admiration: "Young Master has great insight and can kill two birds with one stone.
We really need to see if this ‘20% off’ offer of incense is worth our continued investment! "
He sighed in his heart: The young master always thinks carefully when he acts, and he always thinks about the next step. He is really beyond his reach.
